comment: mkobj.c start_corpse_timeout() during mkmaze.c populate_maze(): a corpse made while a maze level is filled (here inside a random ice box) still draws rnd.c rnz(), and C logs the rnz() result after its rn2() and rne() draws. A debug elven Priestess level-teleports to Dlvl 22, 23 and 24; Dlvl 24 is a maze whose random objects include corpses. The seed was found by running the port alone over fresh seeds and keeping the first one whose maze fill made a corpse; it and the date were chosen independently of every recorded session.
